Name: ClaudeDeck
Author: Rezondes

Actions.Name: Allow
Actions.Tooltip: Approve the pending Claude Code permission request once.

Actions.Name: Always Allow
Actions.Tooltip: Approve and stop asking for this kind of request for the rest of the session.

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Reject the pending Claude Code permission request.

Actions.Name: Claude Status
Actions.Tooltip: Live status and context usage of a Claude Code session. Press to focus its window.

Actions.Name: Claude Window
Actions.Tooltip: Maximize the Claude Desktop window and bring it forward, or minimize it when maximized.

Actions.Name: Plan Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Claude plan usage of the 5 hour and 7 day limits. Press to show when they reset.

Actions.Name: Claude Project
Actions.Tooltip: Open threads and the most urgent state of a Claude Code project. Press to open its most urgent thread in Claude Desktop.

Actions.Name: Claude Reload
Actions.Tooltip: Press to reread Claude Desktop sessions, projects and context and redraw all keys. Hold for 0.6 s to restart the plugin.

Description: Approve Claude Code permission prompts and watch session status from your Stream Deck. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
